reason: Schedule and feasibility lens: the idea can be implemented, but it cannot be scored by 29 Sep 10:00 UTC with >= 70% probability, because it is a gated rider on H1, which is itself unlikely to ship. Checks: (1) The cited numbers hold. r2_critic.notes.md l.16 gives a_never GT->Ultrack 2.3 um and swap 2.4 vs 3.7 um, but it is measured on only 25/63 placeable 44b6 clips, and 'z-blurred' is an interpretation. l.18 gives repulsion of +0.55..+1.0 um. fn_anatomy_exp39.md l.9 gives a_never 1907 = 167 (44b6) + 1740 (6bba). predict_unet_transformer.py l.256-295 is a strict 3x3x3 max-pool local max. x138 cell 4 l.61 has downsample (1,4,4), so the grid is 1.625 um isotropic as claimed. (2) Implementation is small and possible: det_logits[f_idx][0] is on the GPU at the 'lowdet peaks' anchor (x138 cell 4 l.487), so the LoG and its maxima cost about 30 lines and negligible GPU time. Two things in the description are wrong, though. (a) 'Append to the lowdet dump' contaminates the control. x138's gap filler reads low_coords/low_score at score >= 0.5 (cell 5 l.1200-1204), so shoulder peaks in that array change the CONTROL arm of H1's lab and x138's own output. They must go in separate npz keys. (b) The 'lowdet peaks' anchor is shared with the V1284 patch, and x138's own comments record a SILENT failure from exactly this collision (cell 4 l.502-509, x122: 'LOW-DETECTION DUMP SKIPPED (non-fatal) ... anchor count=0'). A third patch on the same anchor needs a hard assert, not the non-fatal try/except. A toy 3D check (scipy, 180 two-Gaussian z-merged configs on the 1.625 um grid) supports only a modest mechanism: 60 configs have no raw peak within 3 um of the second nucleus, and -LoG at sigma 1 voxel plus the 3.5 um exclusion rescues 12/60 (20%) with 0 spurious peaks. (3) The schedule fails. The readouts need GT, so they need H1's x138-on-train lab. That lab does not exist yet: build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 supports only divinsert/leafprune (l.12-18), and the sibling verdict v_literature_byte-lowscore-extension_schedule.json estimates the harness at 4-5 agent-h, with a GPU start on vitalii no earlier than 26 Sep 00:05 UTC, realistically ~06:00 because agents may not push kernels. The shoulder dump must be in that kernel from the first push (25 Sep ~23:00), otherwise it needs its own GPU run. The chain to a scored probe multiplies: P(H1 lab runs on time) ~0.7 x P(H1 lab gate passes) ~0.35-0.45 x P(shoulder readout 1 >= 5% AND readout 2 >= +0.0005 with each embryo >= 0) ~0.15-0.3 x P(calendar) ~0.9, giving ~0.03-0.08. These are GUESSES; the shoulder factor follows the value verdict's central estimate of +0.0002, which is below its own +0.0005 gate. Shipping it ungated alongside H1 raises this only to about the H1 figure (~0.2-0.25), still far below 0.7. (4) Even when it is scored, the LB cannot read it. Its expected effect of ~+0.0002 (value verdict) is about 1/15 of LB noise (0.003, BRIEF s.1). Folded into the first H1 probe, it contaminates H1's reading. As a second probe (H1+shoulder vs H1), the delta is noise. The idea's own timing is also internally inconsistent: it assumes a 'second H1 probe' on 27 Sep 08:00-10:00, but H1's schedule plans one probe on 26 Sep, and a second one exists only if the first succeeds. (5) Minor: the dummy-clip route (4 clips, GT in sasyami/biohub-friend-a-b20-cache) holds only ~30 a_never GT nodes (1740/128x2 + 167/71x2), too few for a 5% kill test, and it is in-sample for the detector.
fix_if_any: Repair it as a zero-slot DIAGNOSTIC and never as an LB probe. (a) Write the patch with SEPARATE npz keys (shoulder_coords int16 at full resolution, shoulder_score, shoulder_flag). Do not append to low_coords, so the gap filler, readmit and the H1 control stay byte-identical. SHOULDER=0 must reproduce exp56 exactly (sha check in build_probe_kernel.py). Chain its replacement text inside the 'lowdet peaks' replacement, not on the raw anchor, and make a missing anchor FATAL in lab kernels. Test it on CPU in the container (pip torch CPU) with synthetic merged blobs, confirming 0 extra peaks on an isolated blob and >= 1 on a z-merged pair. Also run compile() on the patched predict script. 2 agent-h, 25 Sep before ~20:00 UTC, so it reaches H1's lab builder before the first push. (b) Add it to the FIRST x138 GPU run after the reset, whichever comes first: H1's lab (54 videos) or any private dummy run. The dump is free. (c) Readout 1 on CPU in the container once the user pastes the Kaggle key: the share of a_never GT nodes with a shoulder-only hypothesis within 3 um. Report 44b6 by leak group. Kill below 20% of a_never, which is stricter than 5% of FN-edge nodes, or if shoulder hypotheses exceed 5% of nodes per frame. (d) Only if (c) passes AND H1 ships: add one flagged arm to H1's existing CPU arm tails in the same lab. Expect +10-30% tail time per shard, still under REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000. Fold it into a LATER H1 probe only if it gives >= +0.001 with each embryo >= 0 and node ratio <= +0.5%. Hard stop: no result by 27 Sep 18:00 UTC -> SHOULDER=0 in all finals. Never give it its own slot.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0000..+0.0005 on top of H1 (central ~+0.0002, agreeing with the value verdict). This is invisible under 0.003 LB noise. It is 0 in the likely case that it never ships (P ~0.9).
realistic_private_gain: +0.0000..+0.0008 (central ~+0.0003; GUESS). It is larger only if a private embryo is dense and z-blurred. The toy 3D check rescues ~20% of merged pairs in idealised maps; real out-of-sample maps can add ringing, which costs nodes at -0.0009 per +1%.

Submit 26 Sep ~16:00-18:00 or 27 Sep 08:00-10:00, scored 27 Sep ~02:00 or ~18:00. The calendar slack is ~40-55 h, so the calendar is not the binding constraint; the gate chain is. P(a scored LB probe containing it by 29 Sep 10:00) ~0.03-0.08 gated, ~0.2-0.25 as an ungated H1 rider (GUESSES). Both are < 0.7. Friend A/sasyami is not needed (and not reliable); friend B is not used.
